_comment: Frame registry. name -> IP (adb), profile (ha-config profiles key). Per-frame HA tokens live OUTSIDE the repo at ~/.config/frame-ha/<name>.json (url, token, frame). update-frame.sh fails hard if that file is missing - it never silently redeploys the previous frame's token. Fill IPs as each frame is taken over; DHCP-reserve each unit's wlan0 MAC. DUAL IP NOTE (alexa): the frame currently answers on the stale dynamic lease .207 (its dhcpcd lease file in /data keeps re-requesting it and the DHCP server honours it, even across cold boots); the UniFi MAC reservation for .198 has not been picked up yet. WHEN THE CHANGEOVER COMPLETES: forget the .207 lease in UniFi, bounce the frame's WiFi, verify it answers at .198, then swap ip and reserved_ip below and delete this sentence.
